subject: Deployment envelope & staffing ask — VPC / on-prem feasibility
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Aurelia Health <devops@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Deployment envelope & staffing ask — VPC / on-prem feasibility

Hi team,

Following our product sync last week, attaching a compact proposal and a network sketch to start a pragmatic feasibility check for Aurelia's private hosting ask. High-level ask: confirm whether we can deliver a staged pilot within a constrained "deployment envelope" (minimal infrastructure + explicit exceptions) and what headcount/time we need from Redwood and Aurelia to get to a production-ready path.

Key context (short):
- Customer: Aurelia Health (clinical SaaS) — strong data residency + audit needs.
- Goal: a 3-month pilot (staging -> limited prod) that proves latency, cost per inference, and auditability.
- Constraint: Aurelia prefers an air-gapped-ish VPC with no public egress for inference data; their procurement cycle wants a clear SOW and a minimal ops footprint.

Immediate asks from Redwood side:
1) Architecture acceptance criteria: list must-haves (KMS integration, audit log retention window, allowed egress endpoints) and must-not-haves (no outbound model telemetry).
2) Exceptions we will need to request (e.g., temporary reduced HA during pilot, single-region requirement, reduced oncall staffing).
3) Headcount: SRE/infra support, solutions eng for onboarding, one security reviewer. Rough initial estimate: 2x infra eng (pilot), 1x solutions lead, 0.5x security/compliance.
4) Timeline: can we commit to starting cluster provisioning by 6/28 if procurement sign-off comes by 6/20?

Attachments: redwood-proposal-aurelia-v1.pdf, network-envelope-sketch.png, pilot-scope-matrix.xlsx

Can Karthik, Grace, Markus — please weigh in on architecture and security asks by EOD 6/14 so I can prepare an SOW draft for Aurelia's procurement?

Thanks — I kept this tight because Aurelia needs a concise decision path to their execs.

— Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Aurelia Health <devops@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-14T12:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment envelope & staffing ask — VPC / on-prem feasibility

Naomi — thanks for the concise framing. Quick architectural read and a suggested minimal pilot envelope: 

Minimal pilot (non-negotiables):
- Single AZ VPC with dedicated GPU nodes (A100 or equivalent). NVMe-backed local storage for model artifacts and KV cache.
- KMS integration (bring-your-own-key) for model and inference encryption at rest.
- Private TLS inter-node communication; no public IPs on inference nodes.
- Audit log forwarding to a customer-controlled collector over a peered private link.

Possible exceptions (to request formally):
- Reduced HA: pilot runs with single replica for the model-serving pool (SLO relaxation); plan for multi-replica in prod.
- Limited telemetry: allow host-level metrics to be forwarded to Redwood for a 30-day window; otherwise zero outbound telemetry.
- Kernel/runtime constraints: certain kernel optimizations (cuda/cuBLAS versions) will be required — if Aurelia cannot provide, we may need to run in a dedicated Bare Metal arrangement (adds procurement lead time).

Operational staffing (recommended for pilot duration):
- Redwood: 2 infra engineers for provisioning + 1 on-call rotation (shared across pilots), 1 solutions engineer for onboarding and runbooks, 0.5 security/compliance support.
- Aurelia: one DevOps engineer available for network changes, one procurement/approver (brief weekly check-ins).

Critical path items (we should list clearly in SOW):
1) KMS HSM access design and approvals (customer side) — blocker.
2) Network peering CIDR & firewall rules — blocker.
3) Procurement for GPU nodes / cloud reservations or access to on-prem hardware — long-lead.
4) Compliance evidence (SOC2 artifacts) — dependency on Redwood Security team.

I can draft a condensed architecture appendix with the minimum AMIs, driver versions, and networking diagram by EOD 6/15. If Aurelia can confirm available GPU SKU and whether they can allow outbound peering to our telemetry collector for 30 days, we can lock the provisioning window.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aurelia Health <devops@aureliahealth.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-14T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment envelope & staffing ask — VPC / on-prem feasibility

Adding the security lens — thanks for pulling this together. Short answers and resource asks: 

Security / compliance must-haves for pilot acceptance:
- BYOK/KMS integration with split-knowledge HSM or dedicated customer KMS key; keys must not be exportable.
- Audit log retention policy of 180 days for the pilot evidence (we can store longer later).
- Network egress policy: only approved collector endpoints; deny all other outbound.
- Vulnerability baseline for host images (CIS-lite) and a signed SBOM for any non-standard packages.

We can accept a reduced HA for the pilot under a documented exception but require a rollback plan and a timeboxed SLA exception (30 days). Exceptions we will own: we need a signed exception form, and a named security reviewer from Aurelia who will sign off on the risk acceptance.

Resource asks from Aurelia (to attach to SOW):
- Contact for KMS/HSM admin and DPO (data protection officer) contact.
- Confirmation of data residency policy (which region/organization owns keys).
- Procurement contact for any vendor approvals (e.g., if Bare Metal host procurement is necessary).

From Redwood: we will provide a 2-hour architecture/security walkthrough, a compressed onboarding runbook, and a 4-week support window post-pilot with one named reviewer from security on-call.

I will prepare the exception form and a short risk register template. Naomi — if you can attach the PoC timeline to the SOW, I can inline the security acceptance criteria.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Governance & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Aurelia DevOps <devops@aureliahealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@aureliahealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-15T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment envelope & staffing ask — VPC / on-prem feasibility

Naomi / Redwood team — thanks for the plan and the clear asks. We can support a staged pilot under the conditions listed with a few notes from our side: 

Customer notes / constraints:
- Procurement: our internal purchase approval for any Bare Metal procurement will take ~3 weeks; cloud reservations are preferable.
- We can provide a private VPC in our GCP org (us-west2) with peering to your collector endpoints for the 30-day telemetry window.
- KMS: we use Google Cloud KMS with CMEK keys; we need to confirm whether Redwood can integrate to CMEK without key export.
- We will appoint DPO (Anika Shah) and a DevOps lead (Ravi Menon) as points of contact for provisioning and security sign-off.

Proposed near-term timeline:
- 6/20: procurement prelim sign-off if SOW is received by 6/17.
- 6/28: earliest provisioning start if procurement completes on schedule.
- Pilot window: target 8/1 — 10/1 with a 2-week buffer for smoke testing.

We will review your SOW and the exception form once you circulate them. For the architecture appendix, please include the expected outbound IPs and required port ranges for the collector and bootstrap services — we will need that to open firewall rules.

Forwarded message: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

[original proposal files attached: redwood-proposal-aurelia-v1.pdf, network-envelope-sketch.png, pilot-scope-matrix.xlsx]

— Ravi Menon
Aurelia Health — DevOps
devops@aureliahealth.com
